faq.q: Does signing from another country mean FIRPTA applies?
faq.a: Signing location does not settle your federal tax status. Have a qualified tax professional and the closing team verify how the rules apply to the actual owner or owners.

faq.q: Is FIRPTA withholding my final tax bill?
faq.a: No. Withholding is money collected in advance. Your tax professional can explain how the sale and any withholding credit are handled on the applicable return.

faq.q: Does an all-cash sale avoid FIRPTA?
faq.a: Do not assume so. The rules are about the transfer and the applicable parties and exceptions, rather than whether the buyer uses a mortgage.

faq.q: What if my tax professional thinks a reduced amount applies?
faq.a: Ask how the closing team will document the applicable treatment and what remains unresolved. An application or a proposed estimate is not the same as an approved withholding certificate.

substantiveDifference: FIRPTA closing withholding, seller tax-status verification and net-sheet treatment are distinct from 1099-S reporting, county tax proration and signing logistics. Original hypothetical separates amount realized, withholding, closing cash and final tax.
